invariants.rationale: Partition count is typically expected to be positive for partitioning to make sense.
Many Java APIs expect method parameters that are collections to be non-null; this enables safe access like records.isEmpty().
Common practice is to not create more partitions than records unless records is empty, though the implementation may allow it.
Ensures the passed 'records' parameter is a List as expected by the method signature.
At least one partition is typically required; partitioning into zero or negative partitions is not meaningful.
